police-bazar.name: Police Bazar
police-bazar.about:
Police Bazar, known in Khasi as Khyndailad, is one of the historic neighbourhoods of Shillong and is described as an important economic centre and the main commercial hub of the city. Shops, offices and eateries line its streets, and homes sit in the lanes and roads that branch away from the busy core, such as Jail Road, Quinton Road, Thana Road and the Umsohsun side. Police Bazaar and Jail Road are both wards of the Shillong Municipal Board.

Neighbouring localities include Secretariat Hills, Lachumiere and Laitumkhrah, with the old market area of Iewduh (Bara Bazar) close by. Shillong has no railway connection, so tutors here travel by shared taxi, city bus or their own vehicle, and the central location makes Police Bazar easy to reach from most parts of the city. Because the commercial core is crowded through the day, families often choose a slot outside shop hours, and a clear landmark or building name helps a tutor find a flat above a shopfront on the first visit. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

jaiaw.name: Jaiaw
jaiaw.about:
Jaiaw is one of Shillong's historic neighbourhoods and an old residential part of the city that was once included within the village of Mawkhar when the municipality was formed in 1878. Today it is a ward of the Shillong Municipal Board, with its own post office, and its lanes include Jaiaw Laitdom and homes along GS Road, Lawmali Road, Lumdiengjri Road and Mawkhar Main Road.

Garikhana, Police Bazar and Bara Bazar are its close neighbours, and the locality runs up towards Mawlai on its northern side, so tutors from the central wards or from Mawlai can usually take on a Jaiaw home without much travel. Many homes are reached through narrow, sloping lanes, so families should share a nearby landmark or the name of the lane and say whether the last stretch is on foot. Evening slots are popular with school students, and in the monsoon months it is sensible to keep a little extra time in hand for heavy rain. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

mawkhar.name: Mawkhar
mawkhar.about:
Mawkhar is one of the oldest parts of Shillong: it was one of the two villages, with Laban, that were brought into the Shillong municipality under an agreement of 1878, and the old Mawkhar village covered Jaiaw and parts of Jhalupara and Mawprem as well. It remains a ward of the Shillong Municipal Board, and its streets include GS Road, Mawkhar Main Road, Lumdiengjri Road and Basnet Lane.

The locality sits beside the Iewduh (Bara Bazar) market area and the Jhalupara bus stand on GS Road, which brings shops and wholesale trade close to the residential lanes. For a tutor this means good access by shared taxi and city bus, but the market roads are busy in daytime, so late-afternoon or evening sessions after the trading rush work well. Families in older houses in the inner lanes should give a clear landmark; for flats above shops, share the floor and a phone number. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

mawprem.name: Mawprem
mawprem.about:
Mawprem is a long-established residential part of central Shillong. When the municipality was formed in 1878, part of Mawprem fell within the old village of Mawkhar, and Mawprem is now a ward of the Shillong Municipal Board in its own right. Local listings divide it into Upper Mawprem and Lower Mawprem, near the Garikhana area.

Its neighbours include Garikhana, Jaiaw, Mawkhar and the Jhalupara side of GS Road, so tutors who already teach in the central wards are close at hand. Homes here are mostly reached from the hill roads and connecting lanes rather than from a single main road, so it helps to tell a new tutor whether you are in Upper or Lower Mawprem and to give a landmark such as a church, shop or bus stop. City buses and shared taxis serve the Jhalupara end, and a weekday evening slot agreed in advance keeps classes regular through the school term. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

laban.name: Laban
laban.about:
Laban is one of Shillong's historic neighbourhoods. It was one of the two villages brought into the Shillong municipality in 1878, and at that time it covered Lumparing, Madan Laban, Kench's Trace and Rilbong, names still used for its parts today. Laban, Lumparing and Kenches Trace are wards of the Shillong Municipal Board, and the area has its own police station.

Streets and lanes in the locality include Assam Club Lane, Howell Road, Jackson Trace Road and the Kench's Trace road, with a local market near the Last Stop area and Lawsohtun alongside. Bara Bazar and the Rilbong side connect Laban to the city centre, so shared taxis and city buses give tutors a straightforward route in. When booking, say which part of Laban you live in, as Lumparing, Madan Laban, Kench's Trace and Rilbong are each well known by their own names. In heavy rain, allow extra time for the hill roads. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

lawsohtun.name: Lawsohtun
lawsohtun.about:
Lawsohtun is a census town within the Shillong urban area and is listed as one of the towns of the wider Shillong metropolitan region. It lies on the Laban side of the city and local listings place it with Laban, with streets such as Jackson Trace Road and the Mawsynram–Shillong road running through or near it.

For families, Lawsohtun works as a quieter residential pocket next to Laban, Lumparing and Rilbong, so tutors who already teach in Laban are the natural first choice for home classes. Many homes are reached by sloping lanes off the main roads, so share a clear landmark on the first visit and mention if the last part of the way is a footpath with no space to park. Shared taxis on the Laban routes help tutors without their own vehicle. For subjects where a local tutor is hard to find, an online class on a fixed timetable can sit alongside home sessions. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

upper-shillong.name: Upper Shillong
upper-shillong.about:
Upper Shillong is the higher part of the city on the way up towards Shillong Peak, the hill that overlooks Shillong and gives the city its name. It includes villages such as Nonglyer and Laitmynsaw, with village homes spread across the hillside. Elephant Falls, a well-known waterfall, lies in Upper Shillong opposite Mattilang Park in Laitmynsaw.

Because Upper Shillong sits well above the main town and away from the central wards, fewer tutors live close by, and families often combine a home tutor for younger children with online classes for senior subjects. Families should share a clear landmark and check any entry arrangements a visiting tutor needs before the first class. Weather can change quickly at this height, so in rain, mist or cold winter evenings an earlier slot is usually easier for a tutor coming up from the city. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

laitumkhrah.name: Laitumkhrah
laitumkhrah.about:
Laitumkhrah is a census town within Shillong whose name comes from the Khasi word for free and the Umkhrah river, which rises here. It is often called the heart of Shillong and is known as a centre of education, with many schools, colleges, churches and a busy local market. Older buildings have steadily been replaced by newer ones, and its streets include Laitumkhrah Main Road, Bomfyle Road and Hopkinson Road.

Three roads lead from Laitumkhrah to Happy Valley (Them Basuk), Umpling and New Colony, and a road via Goraline links it to Rynjah. Close neighbours include Malki, Lachumiere, Nongrimbah and Nongthymmai. With so many students living and studying here, demand for home tuition is steady, and tutors can reach the area easily by shared taxi or city bus. School and college traffic is heaviest at opening and closing times, so evening slots are usually smoother. Families in flats should share the building name and floor in advance. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

malki.name: Malki
malki.about:
Malki is one of the historic neighbourhoods of Shillong and a ward of the Shillong Municipal Board. It includes Dhankheti and Risa Colony, and the national highway through Shillong passes along it. Local listings place it next to Lachumiere, Laitumkhrah, Nongthymmai, Secretariat Hills and Lyndhurst Estate.

Its position between the city centre and Laitumkhrah means tutors coming from either side have a short, familiar route, and the Dhankheti and Malki bus stops on the main road help those who use public transport. Homes range from older houses in the inner lanes to newer buildings along the main road, so tell a new tutor which entrance to use and where they can park a two-wheeler. Many families here prefer a weekday evening slot plus an extra weekend class before exams. For senior subjects or a specific board, online classes on NXTutors can fill gaps that a local tutor cannot. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

nongthymmai.name: Nongthymmai
nongthymmai.about:
Nongthymmai is a census town within the Shillong urban area; its name comes from the Khasi words nong, village, and thymmai, new, so it literally means the new village. It is one of Shillong's historic neighbourhoods and includes areas such as Jingkieng and Motinagar, with the national highway through the city passing along it.

Neighbouring localities include Nongrimbah, Malki, Laitumkhrah, Pohkseh, Mawblei and Madanrting, so tutors already teaching in Laitumkhrah or Malki can usually add a Nongthymmai home without a long trip. Bus stops at Jingkieng and the Fire Brigade stand at Motinagar are handy reference points for a first visit. Many homes are in lanes that climb off the main road, so share a lane name and a landmark, and say whether a car can reach the gate. Slots just after school hours are in demand, so book early in the term if you need a fixed weekday time. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

rynjah.name: Rynjah
rynjah.about:
Rynjah is a residential locality beyond Laitumkhrah with its own post office and police station. A road via Goraline links Laitumkhrah and Rynjah, and local streets include the Lapalang football ground road and numbered bylanes. Its neighbours include Umpling, Nongrimbah, Demthring, Nongthymmai and Laitumkhrah.

For a tutor, Rynjah is easy to fold into a round of classes that already includes Laitumkhrah or Nongthymmai, and the Rynjah and Pohkseh bus stops make it reachable without a vehicle. Lanes here are often named by bylane number, so families should share the bylane and a nearby landmark when booking a demo. Where a house is down steps from the road, mention it so the tutor can plan where to park. Evening sessions are the usual choice for school students, and in heavy monsoon rain a short online class can stand in for a home visit. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

umpling.name: Umpling
umpling.about:
Umpling is a census town listed among the towns of the Shillong metropolitan region. It is one of the three places linked to Laitumkhrah by its own road, and it lies beside Rynjah, sharing the Rynjah post office, with Pohkseh, Nongrimbah and Itshyrwat also nearby. Nongrah is one of the localities within or next to it.

Families in Umpling usually look first for tutors from Rynjah, Laitumkhrah and Nongthymmai, since the road from Laitumkhrah makes the trip straightforward. The Lapalang and Nongrah bus stops are useful meeting points for a tutor coming by public transport. As many homes are some way off the main road, give clear directions and a phone number on the first visit, and agree whether the tutor should come to the gate or be met at the bus stop. For specialist subjects or exam preparation, online classes can be combined with weekly home visits. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

madanrting.name: Madanrting
madanrting.about:
Madanrting is a census town on the edge of Shillong, governed locally through a traditional headman and a village durbar, and it has its own police station and post office. Mawblei, Nongthymmai, Nongrimbah, Pohkseh and Rynjah are its neighbours, and the main road out of the city passes through it with stops at Mawblei and Madanrting.

Because it sits beyond Nongthymmai, families here often look for tutors who already teach in Nongthymmai, Rynjah or Laitumkhrah and can take on one more home along the same road. Public buses and shared taxis on the main road help tutors without a vehicle, and a meeting point at a named bus stop works well for a first visit. In a growing suburb, new lanes may not show on maps, so share a landmark rather than relying on an address alone. Online classes are a practical option for subjects where no tutor nearby is free. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

mawlai.name: Mawlai
mawlai.about:
Mawlai is one of Shillong's historic neighbourhoods and a large census town within the Shillong urban area, with its own post office and police station. It is made up of several localities, among them Mawlai Mawiong, Mawlai Nongpdeng, Mawlai Mawdatbaki and Kynton Massar, and it adjoins Jaiaw on the city side.

Because Mawlai is spread out and has many parts, the first thing to tell a tutor is which Mawlai locality you live in and the nearest bus stop, such as Mawiong, Nonglum or Mawlai Pump. Tutors from Jaiaw and the central wards can reach the nearer parts easily, while families further out often prefer tutors who live in Mawlai itself. Many homes sit on slopes reached by steps or narrow lanes, so mention this when booking. Evening classes after school are the usual choice, and online sessions are useful on days of heavy rain. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

pynthorumkhrah.name: Pynthorumkhrah
pynthorumkhrah.about:
Pynthorumkhrah is a census town within the Shillong urban area. Its localities include Langkyrding, and roads such as the Langkyrding–Mawpat road and the Shyiap–Langkyrding road pass through it. Its neighbours include Mawpat, Nongmynsong, Shyiap and Umshing-Mawkynroh, and Mawpat is itself listed as a separate town of the Shillong metropolitan region.

Families here usually look for tutors who live in Pynthorumkhrah, Mawpat or Nongmynsong, as travel across the city can be slow at peak times. Bus stops at Laitlum, Umkdait and Itshyrwat are handy reference points for a tutor's first visit. Many homes are on lanes off the main roads, so share a landmark and say whether a car or only a two-wheeler can reach your gate. Weekday evening slots fill quickly during exam months, so it is wise to book early, and online classes can cover subjects where no nearby tutor is free. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

nongmynsong.name: Nongmynsong
nongmynsong.about:
Nongmynsong, earlier known as Lalchand Basti, is a census town within the Shillong urban area. It is served from the city centre by taxis and buses running on the route out of the city on that side, and a district road passes through it. Local listings place it next to Pynthorumkhrah, Golf Links, Itshyrwat, Lyndhurst Estate and Rynjah.

Its position between Pynthorumkhrah and Rynjah means tutors from either side can include a Nongmynsong home in a round of classes. The Nongmynsong and Umkdait bus stops on the main road are convenient meeting points for a first visit. Homes are mostly reached from lanes off the main road, so give a lane name or a landmark, and mention any steps down from the road. Weekday evening classes are the usual pattern for school students, with an extra weekend class before exams. Online lessons can cover specialist subjects or days when travel is hard. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

Police Bazar & Jaiaw.fact: Police Bazar (Khyndailad) is one of Shillong's historic neighbourhoods and is described as an important economic centre and major commercial hub of the city.

The Shillong Municipal Board dates back to 1878, when a proclamation constituted Shillong and its suburbs, including the villages of Mawkhar and Laban, as a station under the Bengal Municipal Act of 1876.
The old village of Mawkhar taken into the municipality covered S.E. Mawkhar, Jaiaw and part of Jhalupara and Mawprem, under an agreement dated 15 November 1878.
Shillong Municipal Board wards include Police Bazaar, Jail Road, Mawkhar, Jaiaw and Mawprem.
Ward's Lake, also called Nan Polok, is an artificial horseshoe-shaped lake built in 1894 in the centre of the city near the Raj Bhavan.
Shillong is connected by road but has no rail connection.

Laban & Upper Shillong.fact: When Laban was included in the Shillong municipality in 1878 it covered Lumparing, Madan Laban, Kench's Trace and Rilbong.
Laban, Lumparing and Kenches Trace are wards of the Shillong Municipal Board.
Laban has its own police station under the East Khasi Hills district police.
Lawsohtun is one of the towns listed in the Shillong metropolitan region.
Elephant Falls lies in Upper Shillong, opposite Mattilang Park in Laitmynsaw, near Shillong Peak.
Shillong takes its name from Lei Shyllong, a deity believed to reside on Shillong Peak, which overlooks the city.

Laitumkhrah & Rynjah.fact: Laitumkhrah takes its name from the Khasi word lait (free) and the Umkhrah river, which originates there.
Three roads connect Laitumkhrah to Happy Valley (Them Basuk), Umpling and New Colony.
Laitumkhrah, Madanrting, Nongthymmai and Umpling are among the towns of the Shillong metropolitan region.
Nongthymmai means 'the new village' in Khasi (nong, village; thymmai, new).
Malki and Laitumkhrah are wards of the Shillong Municipal Board.
The district police list police stations at Laitumkhrah, Rynjah and Madanriting and a beat house at Nongthymmai.

Mawlai & Pynthorumkhrah.fact: Mawlai is a census town in East Khasi Hills district and one of Shillong's historic neighbourhoods.
Mawlai, Mawpat, Nongmynsong and Pynthorumkhrah are among the towns of the Shillong metropolitan region.
Nongmynsong was formerly known as Lalchand Basti and is reached from the city centre by taxis and buses running out of the city on that side.
Pynthorumkhrah census town has administration over 5,755 houses.
Mawlai has its own police station under the East Khasi Hills district police.
